usage.callShape: POST https://api.xona-agent.com/base-main/audio/elevenlabs-music with JSON body {prompt, music_length_ms?, output_format?, force_instrumental?}

inputExample.prompt: a short upbeat acoustic guitar loop

quirks: Dynamic pricing: $1 per 120 seconds, max 180000ms (3 min). The registry $0.250 is only a nominal surface price; the real charge scales with music_length_ms (10000ms cost $0.0833 here). Set --cap accordingly for longer tracks.
x402 settlement can fail transiently on-chain ('settle_exact_failed_onchain') returning a 402 with costUsd 0 (no money lost). Simply retry once; the second attempt settled and succeeded.

Body field is 'prompt' (required). Optional: music_length_ms (1000-180000), output_format (e.g. mp3_standard), force_instrumental (bool). Schema is published in the 402 response's extensions.bazaar.schema.
Result is a remote MP3 URL (body.music_url) on a DigitalOcean Spaces CDN, not inline audio bytes — fetch it to download the track.
usage.guide: POST to https://api.xona-agent.com/base-main/audio/elevenlabs-music with JSON {"prompt":"..."}. Optional music_length_ms (1000-180000), output_format, force_instrumental. Dynamic price $1/120s (max 3min); ~$0.08 for 10s, ~$1.50 for full 3min — size cap to duration. Synchronous: read body.music_url for the MP3. Retry once on transient 402 settle_exact_failed_onchain.
